title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Decision dossier for a publicly browsable, execution-locked Agent Studio demo built from completed and deployed scenario snapshots. In addition to the pinned two-project seed, Dossier lifecycle, replay, security, hosting, and reset decisions, it defines a six-case scenario pool, recommends SVG Pelican, Shift Ledger, and The Deep Blue as the first benchmark wave, specifies scripted Orchestrator context-chat runs, a four-category TokenEconomy ledger, immutable Result Dossiers and run history, per-case token caps, staged model comparisons, and clear ownership across the demo, Token Economy, the Agent Studio website, and independently deployed outputs. [Operator approved 2026-08-17: implement as recommended; slices S1-S5 cut as AGT-2666..2670.]
statusReason: Normalized non-conforming status/phase values ("accepted"/"in-progress" are not in the platform's allowed set) to the equivalent canonical values: decided ("Accepted / In progress" in the UI) and testing. Of the five implementation slices, S1 (AGT-2666), S2 (AGT-2667), and S5 (AGT-2670) are archived and delivered; S3 (AGT-2668) and S4 (AGT-2669) are still in 3-progress. This Dossier stays decided, not documented, until S3 and S4 land.
